olivia_t: quick ask — need a 30m just-in-time sudo on prod-analytics to run a pg_restore/rollforward for the model-eval backfill. Will operate on read-replica, won't touch primary, and I’ll redact PII from the dump before import. window: today 22:00–22:30 UTC. can security + oncall sign off? :hand:

maria_g: @olivia_t can you paste the exact command and confirm the redaction script? need to check KMS access and audit plan.

olivia_t: sure — command I plan to run:
```
pg_restore --dbname=analytics_eval -C --no-owner --role=readonly dump_eval_filtered.sql
```
Redaction step: we run `scripts/redact_dump.py --mask-email --hash-ids` producing `dump_eval_filtered.sql`. Script only replaces email/phone/ssn-like patterns and hashes user ids with salt stored in KMS. No credentials in dump.

alex_k: tag SRE — read-replica is ok, but we need to ensure `replica_promote` is disabled and connection poolers set to maintenance. I'll put a quick route rule in haproxy for that window. ping me 10m before.

sam_s: have you run the redact script on a sample dump and validated with the privacy tests? last time we had a leftover plain-text uuid in comments.

olivia_t: yes ran against a 1GB sample. privacy tests (privacy-tests/ci) passed locally (masked emails, hashed ids). I also grepped for common patterns. I'll attach CI output to the PR.

maria_g: ok checklist for sign-off:
- redact script output attached ✅
- KMS unwrap logs reviewed ✅
- audit events will be enabled for `pg_restore` and `psql` calls ✅
- break-glass approvals recorded in ticket

please file the approval ticket in Jira and link it here before the window. Also will require a post-op verification run to confirm no PII in imported tables.

olivia_t: filed: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2345 — contains attachments and CI logs. added escalation contact @alex_k and @sam_s.

sec-bot: Automated check — found KMS key usage for `olivia_t` in last 7 days. No anomalies. Audit retention policy set to 1y for this project.

alex_k: SRE acked in the ticket and I'll be oncall for the window. @maria_g you good for final sign-off?

maria_g: approve for one-time JIT sudo limited to `olivia_t` and `readonly` role usage during window. Post-op verification required within 4h. :white_check_mark:

olivia_t: thanks everyone — will run at 22:05 UTC, will paste run output and verification summary here afterwards. :eyes:
